tour_overview.package_name: The Colonial Golf Clubs of Ceylon – Golf Tour in Sri Lanka

itinerary_breakdown.description: Colombo Kandy Victoria Golf Course & Resort 4 and half hours
Kandy Nuwara Eliya 3 and half hour train journey

cultural_heritage: Tee off in style at iconic courses, combining the thrill of the sport with unmatched elegance, surrounded by breathtaking vistas that enhance your golfing pleasure.
Immerse yourself in the colonial grandeur of Ceylon’s golf clubs, where each swing is a step back in time amid lush landscapes and rich heritage.

Unwind in opulent colonial-era hotels, blending modern comfort with old-world charm. Indulge in luxury and personalized service that transforms your stay into a seamless blend of relaxation and sophistication.
Savor exquisite culinary journeys, from traditional Sri Lankan flavors to international delights, as our expert chefs curate a dining experience that complements the richness of your surroundings.
Indulge in a lavish getaway, where every moment is a celebration of comfort and style. This trip caters to those who appreciate the finer things in life amidst historical surroundings.
Immerse yourself in the colonial era’s allure, exploring the rich history of Ceylon through its prestigious golf clubs, each telling a story of a bygone era.
Perfect for golf lovers seeking a unique blend of sport and history, this tour offers exclusive access to some of Ceylon’s finest and oldest golf clubs.
Beyond golf, discover the vibrant culture of Sri Lanka, with optional excursions to nearby cultural sites, providing a holistic experience that goes beyond the greens.
